meta.header: Things that often go with a lower price. None of them is a verdict; check the home.

texts.flood1: In a FEMA 1% annual chance flood zone ({zone}). Flood insurance is usually required with a mortgage.
texts.flood02: In a FEMA 0.2% annual chance flood zone (moderate risk).
texts.highway: About {distance} m from a highway{label}. Traffic noise is likely.
texts.major_road: About {distance} m from a major road{label}.
texts.rail: About {distance} m from a railway line{label}.
texts.pre1978: Built before 1978: federal lead-based paint disclosure applies.
texts.old_systems: Built in {year}: original roof, HVAC or plumbing may be near the end of their life.
texts.small_lot: Lot smaller than about 90% of similar homes in its appraisal neighbourhood.

meta.distance_note: Distances are approximate: OpenStreetMap centrelines and parcel interior points, not a building or noise measurement.
meta.zone_note: Zone labels describe the dissolved FEMA union; an individual zone boundary is not retained.
meta.lot_note: At least 20 recorded lots in the same county, neighbourhood and category.
